messages.content:
Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.
By which date must Member States provide for the first time the data and information referred to in Article 6(5) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?

response.text: What is the deadline by which Member States must, for the first time, supply the data and information specified in Article 6(5) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?
